definition: to provide lodging or space for someone, or to adapt to someone's needs
example: The new policy aims to accommodate employees with disabilities.

definition: a comparison between two things to explain or clarify something
example: The teacher used a simple analogy to explain how the immune system works.

definition: to expect or predict that something will happen
example: Retailers anticipate a rise in online sales during the holiday season.

definition: to tell someone confidently that something is true, to remove doubt
example: The government assured the public that the water supply was safe.

definition: to succeed in achieving something, usually through effort
example: Many students struggle to attain the grades needed for university admission.

definition: used to indicate that someone is acting or speaking for another person
example: The lawyer spoke on behalf of the affected residents.

definition: the majority or largest part of something
example: The bulk of the company's revenue comes from overseas markets.

definition: to stop happening or doing something
example: The factory ceased production after the fire.

definition: logical and consistent; well organized
example: The essay lacked a coherent structure, making it difficult to follow.

definition: to happen at the same time as something else, or to be in agreement
example: The rise in prices coincided with a shortage of raw materials.

definition: to begin
example: Construction on the new bridge will commence next spring.

definition: able to exist or work together without conflict
example: Remote work is often more compatible with family life than a traditional office job.

definition: happening at the same time as something else
example: The company is running several concurrent projects this quarter.

definition: to keep someone or something within limits
example: The discussion was confined to environmental issues, without touching on economics.

definition: a prolonged public disagreement or debate
example: The new policy sparked considerable controversy among parents and teachers.

definition: opposite or reversed in order, relation, or action
example: Some economists argue the converse: that lower taxes can increase overall revenue.

definition: a piece of equipment designed for a particular purpose
example: Most teenagers now own a mobile device by the age of twelve.

definition: to give a large amount of time or effort to a particular activity
example: Many parents devote considerable time to helping with homework.

definition: to become or make something smaller or less important
example: Public trust in the institution has diminished in recent years.

definition: to give a misleading or false account of something
example: Media coverage can sometimes distort public perception of an issue.

definition: the length of time something lasts
example: The duration of the course has been extended from six to eight weeks.

definition: to gradually wear away or weaken something
example: Public confidence in the government has eroded due to repeated policy failures.

definition: a moral principle that governs behavior
example: A strong work ethic is often valued more than raw talent.

definition: the way something is arranged or presented
example: The exam's format was changed to include more practical assessments.

definition: to establish or set up an institution or organization
example: The charity was founded to support homeless families in the city.

definition: existing as a natural or basic part of something
example: There is an inherent risk in investing in the stock market.

definition: a deep understanding of a person or situation
example: The survey provided valuable insight into consumer behavior.

definition: essential or necessary to make something whole
example: Teamwork is an integral part of most modern workplaces.

definition: at a level between beginner and advanced
example: The course is designed for intermediate learners with some prior experience.

definition: done or operated by hand rather than automatically
example: Many manual jobs are increasingly being replaced by automated machinery.

definition: fully developed, either physically or in behavior and judgment
example: Employers often value mature judgment as much as technical skill.

definition: to intervene between two parties to help resolve a dispute
example: A neutral party was brought in to mediate the dispute between the two companies.

definition: a means by which something is communicated or expressed
example: Television remains an important medium for reaching older audiences.

definition: relating to the armed forces
example: The country increased its military spending amid rising tensions.

definition: of a minimum amount or degree; very small
example: The changes had a minimal effect on overall productivity.

definition: shared by two or more people or groups
example: The agreement was reached through mutual compromise between both sides.

definition: to partly cover or coincide with something else
example: The responsibilities of the two departments sometimes overlap, causing confusion.

definition: accepting what happens without active response; not active
example: A passive approach to learning is generally less effective than active participation.

definition: a part of a whole
example: A significant portion of the population now works in the service industry.

definition: occurring before something more important; introductory
example: Preliminary results suggest the new treatment is effective.

definition: a set of official rules or procedures
example: Hospitals follow strict protocols to prevent the spread of infection.

definition: relating to quality or nature rather than quantity
example: The study combined quantitative data with qualitative interviews.

definition: to improve something by making small changes
example: The company refined its marketing strategy after reviewing customer feedback.

definition: to become or make less tense or strict
example: The government relaxed travel restrictions once cases began to fall.

definition: to hold back or prevent someone from doing something
example: New regulations aim to restrain excessive spending by local governments.

definition: a dramatic and wide-reaching change, or a forcible overthrow of a government
example: The internet sparked a revolution in the way people access information.

definition: unable or unwilling to change; strict
example: A rigid work schedule can make it difficult for parents to manage childcare.

definition: a way or course taken to get from one place to another
example: Cyclists have called for safer routes through the city center.

definition: a possible sequence of events or situation
example: Economists have outlined several scenarios for how the economy might recover.

definition: an area of activity or interest
example: Social media now plays a major role in the political sphere.

definition: lower in rank or importance
example: In many companies, short-term profit is treated as subordinate to long-term growth.

definition: to add something to complete or enhance it
example: Many students take part-time jobs to supplement their income.

definition: to temporarily stop something, or to officially exclude someone
example: Flights were suspended due to severe weather conditions.

definition: a group of people working together toward a common goal
example: Successful projects usually depend on effective teamwork rather than individual effort.

definition: lasting for only a limited time
example: Many young people take temporary jobs while studying.

definition: to cause something to happen suddenly
example: A sudden rise in oil prices can trigger inflation across the economy.

definition: to bring together to form a single unit
example: The new curriculum aims to unify teaching standards across the country.

definition: to break or fail to comply with a rule or law
example: The company was fined for violating environmental protection laws.

definition: the ability to think about the future with imagination, or a mental image of what could be achieved
example: The mayor outlined a clear vision for a greener, more livable city.
